{{Quote|I do my best work when I stay in harm's way.|Onar Koma|<ref name="Jabba's Realm" />}}
'''Onar Koma''' was a scarred [[Ualaq/Legends|Ualaq]] [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] that allied himself with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He was a large and extremely strong [[Soldier/Legends|warrior]], and a formidable foe in battle.<ref name="A Step Above Scum">{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/news/2016/9/16/a-step-above-scum|text=A Step Above Scum: Preview the Heroes of Jabba's Realm}}</ref> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] he was joined on a mission to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Shyla Varad/Legends|Shyla Varad]] and [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gunslinger/Legends|gunslinger]], [[Vinto Hreeda/Legends|Vinto Hreeda]].<ref name="IAJR">{{SWIA|set=Jabba's Realm}}</ref>
